Ayodhya Ram Temple Donation Counting Discrepancies Raise Questions

The counting of donations at Ayodhya's Ram temple has raised questions about discrepancies with other temples in Uttar Pradesh. The issue has sparked concerns about the management and transparency of temple finances. The controversy has also drawn attention to the role of politicians in temple affairs.
